findings: Accepted only the registry resource-lifetime invariant. The production diff contains exactly 13 added lines in filter_registry.rs, plus 66 focused test lines. No later sequence model or geometry changes are present.

Pinned Java provenance verified: UGraphicSvg.build line 88 creates a new SvgGraphics; SvgGraphics.filterBackColor is an instance field at line 740; getIdFilterBackColor/getFilterBackColor at lines 742-766 allocate per-instance colors. Rust adapts this ownership to CURRENT. Cleanup at scope exit corrects that lifetime without changing the color or geometry model.

Installation follows the non-reentrancy assertion. The assertion Ref temporary ends before assignment; FilterRegistry::for_source is evaluated before installation. RegistryScope is constructed only after successful installation. A rejected nested call cannot construct its own guard or execute its body.

Normal return moves the actual collected registry and body result to the caller; guard destruction then takes None. The independent normal-transfer test compares all definitions to separately accumulated filters, checks color alias deduplication, verifies the returned Arc pointer identity, and starts a fresh empty scope.

Three caught nested rejections retain outer source-derived IDs and previously collected filters. An uncaught nested rejection removes outer state and permits a new registry. Both retain the exact non-reentrancy panic. A deliberate body panic with existing filters preserves a non-string Arc payload by pointer identity and leaves CURRENT empty.

RefCell/double-panic audit: CURRENT is private and accessed only by with_registry and id_for_current. No client can retain a Ref/RefMut or run client callbacks under a slot borrow. id_for_current returns an owned String. normalize_back_color/normalize_color only perform string/table operations; any borrow from such a call is released before the outer guard unwinds. Registry fields are String and Vec<(String,String)> with no custom destructors or allocation in cleanup. No reachable double panic was found for the current clients.

Client inventory: lib.rs render_under_filter_registry wraps normal/themed/scaled and optional oracle paths; text_render.rs emit_span is the only stateful id_for_current client. Board/state/component/class/sequence/activity use pure seed, gradient, shadow or finalization utilities, not retained CURRENT references. No new fixture-label condition, geometry constant, catch/suppression, or comparator change is present.

Both existing valid checker_live_stack_2 and checker_live_stack_3 still produce the original index-out-of-bounds panic at sequence.rs:8022, len 2 and index 18446744073709551615. Fresh CLI processes exit 101. Repeated same-thread failure/recovery rounds preserve that panic and pass 24/24 subsequent control comparisons against both clean CLI bytes and pinned Java. Baseline fails all 24 recoveries and substitutes registry non-reentrancy for the second initiating attempt.

Four independent lifecycle checks pass on candidate. Baseline normal transfer and caught nesting pass; body-panic cleanup and uncaught-nesting cleanup fail. The baseline driver initially returned 0 despite JSON failures. Candidate main was made fail-closed before execution without changing test assertions or render/comparison operations. Baseline failure claims rely on recorded failed checks, not its exit status.

Original 907 cases from repository-root cwd: candidate has 372 pass, 525 SVG mismatches, 8 invalid references, and 2 initiating panics. All 897 successful renders equal isolated CLI bytes. Baseline had 110 pass, 378 mismatches, 8 invalid references, and 411 panics. The 409 collateral reentrancy failures disappear. Isolated CLI comparison records are identical before and after for every case.

The unchanged built-in full suite runs 913 sources: old 907 plus new 6. It reports 377 pass, 526 mismatches, 8 invalid references and 2 panics. Its exact failure set differs from the root-cwd independent replay only on the existing checker_include_theme source: its relative docs/... include resolves from cwd, and Cargo runs from crates/rustuml-oracle. A targeted replay of all 33 theme cases at crate cwd reproduces exactly that single status change. No fixture, include or harness was altered.

Both full corpus tiers retain integration metrics: product 11181/11251; assisted 10497/11251, with 754 failures, 1299 skipped and zero assisted panics. Product remains red on prior unlocked class/preprocessing/rendering gains. Assisted and full perturbation suites remain red. These are not acceptance for T14 or the campaign.

All six fresh controls are valid pinned-Java references and pass the unchanged strict comparator. Ordinary and background-color SVGs span activity and sequence, changed labels/source seeds, message topology/direction, multiple colors and alias reuse. Existing failed sequence inputs are failure triggers only, never successful controls or waived references.

Unchanged honesty guards finish 4/6: decimal_literal_ratchet and parity_review_records_are_complete remain red on existing residue. No guard diagnostic names render-registry-unwind-scope. This review satisfies the unchanged schema; the global guards are not accepted or waived.

journey_scope.exception: In-process library resource lifetime requires a same-thread client after catch_unwind; fresh CLI subprocesses cannot detect leaked TLS. Real CLI/Java controls complement those lifecycle checks. No live provider or service is part of RustUML.
journey_scope.standing_enforcement: Maker registry tests are wired into the existing library gate. All six new controls are discovered by the existing perturbation gate. checker.rs is additional independent executable evidence; README.md records reproduction.

residue: Global red suites preclude acceptance of T14 or the campaign. No other sequence mechanism is attested.
panic=abort, process termination, allocation abort, unsafe access to private state, and a user destructor panicking during unwind cannot guarantee cleanup and are outside this scope.
